stories.title: Europe targeted by spiralling sabotage campaign, Russia chief suspect
stories.summary: Germany has blamed Russia for an explosive drone found at Leipzig airport, part of a pattern of fires and attacks on defence sites across Europe from Italy to Estonia in August. Intelligence analysts see the campaign as Russia probing NATO's limits while its war in Ukraine intensifies.

stories.title: US investigates deadly strike on Iranian wedding, analysis points to US munition
stories.summary: Washington is investigating a strike on a wedding in southern Iran that VP Vance said the US may have caused; Reuters analysis suggests a US munition hit directly. The case adds tension to US-Iran relations in the Middle East.

stories.title: Germany's AfD eyes first far-right state government since 1945
stories.summary: The far-right AfD is on track to win Sunday's election in Saxony-Anhalt, which would give Germany its first far-right state governor since World War II. The vote is a test for Chancellor Merz's struggling national government.

stories.title: US and China gear up for first AI safety talks in mid-September
stories.summary: Reuters reports the US plans first-ever bilateral talks devoted to AI safety with China, led by Treasury Secretary Bessent, covering AI-linked cyberattacks and lab self-policing. They come as frontier AI capabilities reach what experts call a global tipping point.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra begins rollout through Microsoft Foundry
stories.summary: Microsoft said GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI's newest frontier model, starts rolling out Friday through its Foundry Limited Access Program after Thursday's launch. It is OpenAI's first model to reach the Critical cyber threshold, making access rules as consequential as the performance jump.

stories.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra tested on ARC-AGI-3 benchmark
stories.summary: ARC Prize published its independent evaluation of GPT-6 Astra on the ARC-AGI-3 reasoning benchmark, a headline result in the model's first week. The results are being read as a signal of how close the model is to broad general intelligence.

stories.title: Qwen 3.8 27B now available on Cerebras at 1500 tokens/sec
stories.summary: Alibaba's Qwen 3.8 27B open multimodal model is now served on Cerebras hardware at around 1,500 tokens per second. The high-speed deployment makes the agentic coding model far more practical for long AI-agent workflows.

stories.title: Browns face a relatively easy 2026 schedule before Week 11 bye
stories.summary: Analysis notes the Browns play just five teams that made last year's playoffs in 2026, all before their Week 11 bye, setting up a manageable early stretch. A strong start would build momentum for a team aiming to improve on 2025.

stories.title: Five storylines to watch as No. 1 Ohio State opens vs. Ball State
stories.summary: Ohio State kicks off its 2026 season Saturday at Ohio Stadium against Ball State, with storylines including the debut of new coordinator Arthur Smith's offense and quarterback Julian Sayin's season as a Heisman finalist. The top-ranked Buckeyes open the year as heavy favorites.

stories.title: LeBron James narrates Ohio State's Ball State game trailer
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors published the season-opener hype trailer, narrated by NBA star and frequent Ohio State donor LeBron James with a Metallica soundtrack. It sets the tone for Saturday's opener against Ball State at the Shoe.

stories.title: Gasly loses Monaco GP podium as FIA Court of Appeal reinstates penalties
stories.summary: The FIA International Court of Appeal upheld pit-lane speeding penalties against Pierre Gasly, stripping his Monaco podium from May and dropping Alpine to seventh, with Hadjar inheriting third. The ruling also shakes up the F1 championship standings.

stories.title: Leclerc leads Ferrari 1-2 in first practice for Italian GP
stories.summary: Charles Leclerc headed a Ferrari one-two ahead of Lewis Hamilton in Friday's FP1 at Monza, with the Tifosi getting a strong start to the team's home race. George Russell was third for Mercedes as the Italian GP weekend opened.

stories.title: Norris' new race team received 'a few hundred job requests' in first hour
stories.summary: Lando Norris said his newly announced junior racing team got a few hundred job applications within an hour of going public. The team, set to enter F3 in 2027, is building out staff ahead of its debut.

stories.title: Netflix releases trailer for 'Schumacher '94' documentary
stories.summary: Netflix dropped the trailer for "Schumacher '94 — The Birth of a Legend," covering Michael Schumacher's first F1 world championship in 1994 via interviews and archive footage. The documentary arrives as Ferrari honors Schumacher at this weekend's Italian GP.

stories.title: Game-day guide: heavy traffic expected around Ohio Stadium Saturday
stories.summary: Columbus police and ODOT are warning of heavy traffic around Ohio Stadium for Saturday's Buckeyes opener, with SR-315 backups and one-way reconfigurations near the Shoe. Fans are urged to plan routes early and avoid GPS rerouting.
